source_axes: X right, Y back, Z up; front -Y

collider_schema.space: Blender mesh local, metres; ignore master display translations
collider_schema.classification: solid and walkable both block all faces; walkable identifies intended traversal surfaces; never use as trigger
collider_schema.supports_standing: solid fence/rail tops also support standing when marked
collider_schema.union: All proxies combine by union; never replace by a module AABB
collider_schema.consumer_import: Apply the identical axis/unit conversion used by the imported render mesh to proxy centres and orientation matrices. These values remain Blender mesh-local; Unity axis conversion has not been engine-tested. Never reorder quaternion components as an axis conversion.
